title: Gold Bar Reload Tobacco Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2 x Pods
description: Gold Bar Reload Tobacco Prefilled Pods deliver a smooth, full-bodied Tobacco flavour with a subtly earthy finish. This profile is warm and rounded, offering a familiar experience that many vapers appreciate for its simplicity and depth. Each pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, designed for a smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape using the Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit. The integrated mesh coil ensures consistent vapour production and balanced flavour throughout. Easy to install and ready to use straight from the pack, these pods offer a clean and convenient vaping experience for those who enjoy a more traditional flavour with minimal setup.
